$comment: A version of the film is {music, edit, sfxSet}. The version ID is the MUSIC version's ID, because that is what `tools/use-music.mjs` flips and what `render.ps1 -Version` takes; this file says what else travels with it. Nothing here is derived — it is the one place the three axes are tied together.

A-confident-arrival.note: Rendered, approved, and re-renderable byte for byte. Its resolved timeline is locked in edit-a-timeline.lock.json.

B-daylight-forward.note: Re-arranged around the second take: brighter, faster, cut on the bar grid. The sfxSet stays `synth` until the ElevenLabs set lands on its own branch.
